mentions.description: A language learning app the author has been working on. At its most basic it keeps track of the user's SRS (spaced repetition) items and builds stories in worlds the user can create to help review them. The author says it combines things they have wanted as a language learner with their favorite aspects of various apps they use.
mentions.audience: Language learners who want spaced-repetition review woven into stories in worlds they create.
mentions.author: JimboOmega
